silhouette.definition:
n. an outline of a solid object (as cast by its shadow)
n. a drawing of the outline of an object; filled in with some uniform color
v. project on a background, such as a screen, like a silhouette
v. represent by a silhouette
silhouette.translation:
n. 黑色半身侧面影, 影子, 轮廓, 剪影
vt. 描绘...成侧面影, 使照出影子来, 使仅仅显出轮廓

silhouetted.definition:
v project on a background, such as a screen, like a silhouette
v represent by a silhouette
silhouetted.translation: a. 显出轮廓的, 显示影像的

silhouettes.definition:
n an outline of a solid object (as cast by its shadow)
n a drawing of the outline of an object; filled in with some uniform color
v project on a background, such as a screen, like a silhouette
v represent by a silhouette
silhouettes.translation: n. 轮廓( silhouette的名词复数 ); （人的）体形; （事物的）形状; 剪影

silhouetting.definition:
v project on a background, such as a screen, like a silhouette
v represent by a silhouette
silhouetting.translation: vt. 使呈现影子（silhouette的现在分词形式）

silhouettist.translation: n. 轮廓, 剪影 (silhouette的变形)
